issue: BC evaluation initially retained FrankaAutonomousEnv defaults (max_move 0.025 m and max_time 12 s) instead of the frozen checkpoint settings (0.15 m and 16 s). This made those initial validation rollouts invalid.
correction: Set max_move and max_time from the frozen BC checkpoint before corrected validation; reran all six BC policies on their prescribed validation seed range.

checkpoint_pairing_issue.issue: The first SAC checkpoint callback attempted to pair 280000-280499 SAC validation rows with BC rows from 270000-270499, causing a seed-key mismatch before any checkpoint selection statistic was computed.
checkpoint_pairing_issue.protocol_amendment: The preregistration now requires BC rollouts on the same 280000-280499 SAC validation positions for the paired regression criterion; all other conditions and Final seeds remain unchanged.
checkpoint_pairing_issue.checkpoint_attempt_status: abandoned and excluded; the first H1/BC42/SAC1103 run was trained to 10000 steps and is being retrained under the amended paired-baseline procedure.

final_evaluation_startup_issue.issue: The SAC Final orchestrator referenced sha256 for frozen checkpoint verification without importing the shared helper, so it stopped before opening or rolling out any SAC Final model.
final_evaluation_startup_issue.correction: Imported the existing action_chunking.sha256 helper. No rollout row, model score, or Final success outcome had been read when fixing this startup-only NameError.

duplicate_rollout_cleanup.method: Kept the first appended row for each protocol seed; no success or performance fields were used to choose rows.

report_generation_issue.issue: The report renderer cast a fractional mean BC inference-call count to int.
report_generation_issue.correction: Changed the renderer to parse mean_bc_calls as float and regenerated the report.
